spec.studio_prompt: A botanical arrangement consisting of a bulbous clear blown-glass vase measuring 30 cm in diameter with glossy highlights in #8a8170. Slender dark brown olive stems (#3a2f1b) emerge from the narrow neck, extending into a 45 cm wide and 70 cm tall canopy. The branches carry dense, small matte leaves in muted olive tones (#716551, #584c37) that naturally spread upward and cascade softly to the right, with submerged woody stems subtly visible through the transparent base.
